title: Elena Verna on B2B SaaS Product-Led Growth and Onboarding Loops
content: PLG onboarding is fundamentally about accelerating time-to-value for the user. Most B2B SaaS companies make the mistake of creating product tours that explain every feature. Instead, product managers should focus on removing friction from the core activation milestone. When users reach activation within their first session, retention curves flatten dramatically and organic growth loops begin to fire.
